# ja.wikipedia.org

> Japanese Wikipedia is a free, collaborative encyclopedia providing comprehensive information across all knowledge domains in the Japanese language.

ja.wikipedia.org is the Japanese language edition of Wikipedia, powered by MediaWiki software. It serves as a comprehensive encyclopedia portal with community-driven content creation, featuring tools for editing, navigation, and knowledge discovery.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- MediaWiki
- Japanese Wikipedia

## Core Pages

- [Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%A1%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%9A%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B8): Japanese Wikipedia homepage with featured articles and encyclopedia portal
- [Wikipedia](https://ja.wikipedia.org/w/index.php): Japanese Wikipedia homepage with featured articles and community content
- [Wikipedia: Community Portal](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E3%82%B3%E3%83%9F%E3%83%A5%E3%83%8B%E3%83%86%E3%82%A3%E3%83%BB%E3%83%9D%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BF%E3%83%AB): Community portal for Japanese Wikipedia contributors and guidelines

## Editing & Documentation

- [Help: Table of Contents](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:%E7%9B%AE%E6%AC%A1): Help index and table of contents for Wikipedia editing and navigation
- [Wikipedia: Sandbox](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E3%82%B5%E3%83%B3%E3%83%89%E3%83%9C%E3%83%83%E3%82%AF%E3%82%B9): Sandbox for editing practice and tutorial for new Wikipedia editors
- [Wikipedia: File Upload](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E3%83%95%E3%82%A1%E3%82%A4%E3%83%AB%E3%81%AE%E3%82%A2%E3%83%83%E3%83%97%E3%83%AD%E3%83%BC%E3%83%89): File upload guide for Wikimedia Commons and free content licensing
- [Wikipedia: Usage Guide](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E5%88%A9%E7%94%A8%E6%A1%88%E5%86%85): FAQ and usage guide for Wikipedia editing and community support
- [Talk: Main Page](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%8E%E3%83%BC%E3%83%88:%E3%83%A1%E3%82%A4%E3%83%B3%E3%83%9A%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B8): Talk page for main page discussions and article quality standards

## Community & Support

- [Wikipedia: Village Pump](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E4%BA%95%E6%88%B8%E7%AB%AF): Village pump discussion forum for community guidelines and editorial policy
- [Wikipedia: Announcements](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E3%81%8A%E7%9F%A5%E3%82%89%E3%81%9B): Announcements and editor notices for project updates and policies
- [Wikipedia: Bug Reporting](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E3%83%90%E3%82%B0%E3%81%AE%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A): Bug reporting guide for MediaWiki and Phabricator technical support
- [Wikipedia: Contact Information](https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:%E9%80%A3%E7%B5%A1%E5%85%88): Contact information and support resources for readers and contributors
